semantics: Only is may omit on; on is has identical meaning. Literal before nominal type is ordered specialization. Unreachable arms remain diagnosed. Unsupported types must fail closed, not count as positive parity.

cases.source: fnc choose(int | string value): int { return match value over { on 42 -> 100; is int -> -20; on _ -> 0; }; }
fnc choose(int | string value): int { return value |> match over { on 42 -> 100; is int -> -20; on _ -> 0; }; }
pub fnc main(): int { return 7 |> await |> match over { on 42 -> 100; is int -> -20; }; }
pub fnc main(): int { return match 7 over { on 42 -> 100; on is int -> -20; }; }
pub fnc main(): int { return match 7 over { 7 -> 42; on _ -> 0; }; }
pub fnc main(): int { return match 7 over { _ -> 0; }; }
pub fnc main(): int { return match 7 over { is -> 42; }; }
pub fnc main(): int { return match 7 over { is int -> 42; on _ -> 0; }; }
